title: marsdawn export --json: success
description: Printed on stdout as one line when `marsdawn export --json` succeeds (exit code 0).

output.description: Absolute path of the PDF that was written.

pages.description: Number of pages in the PDF.

paper.description: Paper size used for the export.

diagramErrors.description: One message per Mermaid diagram that failed to render. The PDF is still written.

message.description: The error message, same text as the matching entry in diagramErrors.

fenceLine.description: The document line the Mermaid fence starts on. Absent only for fences inside footnotes.

line.description: The error's own document line (fenceLine plus Mermaid's line). Present only when Mermaid's message names a line.

diagramErrorDetails.description:
The same failures as `diagramErrors`, in the same order, each as
  `{message, fenceLine, line}`. `fenceLine` is the document line the diagram's fence starts on,
  present whenever that's known. `line` is the document line of the error itself (`fenceLine` plus
  Mermaid's own line number from its message), present only when Mermaid's message names a line —
  some errors, like an undetected diagram type, don't. Either can be absent on its own.
